versions.subject: Clean up MITRE Tagging.  When a type is defined, such as T1003, DO NOT allow a subtype such as T1003.001 to be defined. Remove the generic type T1003 and keep the subtype T1003.001. However, it is acceptable for a subtype to be defined or for a type to be defined separately. It is also okay for multiple subtypes to be defined.
